memory.body: To add a database migration: create a timestamped file under db/migrations, run `make migrate-plan` and review the diff, then `make migrate-apply`. Never edit a migration that has already been applied.

task.query: create a new database migration to add a column to the users table

distractors.body: User avatars are served from /avatars and cached for 24h.
HTTP handlers must return within 30s or the gateway times out.
The staging database is reset every Sunday night; don't rely on its data.
Tried an ORM auto-migrate in 2026-02, it dropped a column, reverted to manual migrations.
